Homies in now heals more, and cost less TP, more homies in!.

Everytime you kill one of the members, the others heal to full.
Fixed a few bugs with the encounter.
[b][u]Floppy Disk[/u][/b]
They got nerfed, they sell for less now.

notes.title: The Floppy Disk Update
notes.content:
[u][b]Save Update[/b][/u]
Saves work differently know, the first time you save your progress, you will be able to choose a game file as usual.
Afterword you will always "automatically" in your current save/load whenever you choose the save option on the Wifi Station. However, you can access the save files if you have a Floppy Disk.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33787851/06e004f1763df23dc75d8b6447845da212d470eb.png[/img]
Floppy Disks are found next to each Wifi Station, and each time you use one to access the save files, you will consume one of your Floppy Disks, so use them wisely.
You can sell Floppy Disks if you dont need them.

[u][b]Hard Mode Update[/b][/u]
You cant use Floppy Disks in Hard Mode, but you might be able to sell them with ease.

[u][b]Casino Update[/b][/u]
Whenever you bet in a slot machine, your progress will be automaticaly saved, even if you win or lose.

[u][b]Complete rework of the SlimS event[/b][/u]
The event is now different, different enemy, different dialogue and less cringe shit.

You cant use Floppy Disks in Hard Mode, but you might be able to sell them with ease.
Whenever you bet in a slot machine, your progress will be automaticaly saved, even if you win or lose.
The event is now different, different enemy, different dialogue and less cringe shit.

notes.title: Plane crash fix
notes.content:
Fixed ([i]i hope so[/i]) a memory leak caused by the plane section in the Jungle, by completly removing the flying section.
To compensate the lack of Annoying Plane Guy music, players will be able to listen to it in the plane jungle section instead.
Also, a Wifi Station was added to the plane jungle section, so if for some reason you crash, you can quickly go back and suffer without interruptions.
